name: gtm-operator
description: The GTM operator mod for Claude Code: scores every go-to-market draft with its own skill pack's scorer, flags stale and inconsistent drafts across packs, pack dashboards, a guided sprint, analytics, and a guard that keeps brand-config.json and SOUL.md merged.

runScorers.title: Run the packs' scorers
runScorers.description: Score each draft with its pack's own Python scorer (runs python3 locally, no network). Off: the board shows progress only.

minScore.title: Minimum score to save a draft
minScore.description: Refuse a Write to a gtm/ or drafts/ draft that scores below this (0-100). 0 turns the gate off.

packsDir.title: Folder holding the pack repos
packsDir.description: Optional. A folder with claude-psp, claude-evp and the rest cloned side by side; searched before the plugin cache and skills folders.

python.title: Python command
python.description: The Python 3 command the scorers run with.
